name: Combat
description: A weapons workbench and the shield you craft on it. The bench costs a crafting table, 3 logs and 5 iron ingots; the shield 4 planks and 4 iron ingots. Hold the use button with the shield in either hand to raise it: monster melee coming at your front is blocked while it is up, you move at half speed, and both hands are committed — no punching, mining or interacting until you lower it. A hit it absorbs knocks it aside for half a second, so a pack of monsters still gets through. Built entirely on the engine's generic body seams — damage cancellation, the speed scale, the barred-action claim, per-hand held poses, rig bone offsets and the server-to-client cue — with every shield rule authored in the mod and predicted client-side.
summary: Adds a weapons workbench and a shield that blocks monster melee from the front, and reels when it does.
